name: mqvi Guide
intro: I'm the mqvi Guide, an automatic helper. Here are some things to try — pick any, in any order. I'll tick them off as you go.

community.title: Join a community
community.desc: Browse public communities or create your own server. In a community you can chat, talk in voice and share your screen.

message.title: Say hi in a channel
message.desc: Every community has text channels. Open one and send your first message.

voice.title: Join a voice channel
voice.desc: Channels marked 🔊 are voice channels. Hop in to talk, share your screen or watch others share theirs.

friend.title: Add a friend
friend.desc: Add friends by their username to message and call them directly.

profile.title: Make your profile yours
profile.desc: Add an avatar so people recognise you in chats and voice.

roles.title: Create a role
roles.desc: In a server you own, roles give people colours and permissions — moderators, members, anything you like.

app.title: Get the app
app.desc: mqvi runs on desktop and mobile too: stay in voice in the background and get notifications.

finale: That's everything — you're all set! 🎉 You can hide this guide now; you'll find it again under Settings → Help.
restoreDesc: The step-by-step guide shown to new users. Bring it back to the top of your direct messages.

stage.discovery-join: Pick a community and join it.
stage.composer: Write your first message here and send it.
stage.channel-voice: Click a voice channel to join it.
stage.add-friend-input: Type your friend's username and send the request.
stage.avatar: Tap to choose a picture, then save.
stage.add-server: Create a server of your own here.
stage.voice-mic: Microphone: mute or unmute yourself. The arrow picks which microphone to use.
stage.voice-deafen: Headphones: deafen — you hear no one and your mic turns off too. The arrow sets your output device and volume.
stage.voice-share: Screen share: stream your screen or a window to the channel. The arrow sets the quality.
stage.voice-soundboard: Soundboard: play short sound effects for everyone in the channel.
stage.voice-noise: Noise reduction: filters out background sounds like keyboards and fans.

roles.owned-server: Open your server, then right-click it (long-press on a phone).

rolesNoServer.add-server: Roles live in a server you own — create one here first.

voiceTourDesc: A short walk through the buttons you get in a voice channel.
voiceTourNeedsVoice: Join a voice channel to play it.
